info.name: Returns the paged samples of a benchmark filtered by an identifier.

params.name: benchmarkId
params.description: The id of the benchmark to query.

params.name: identifier
params.description: The identifier to filter all samples for.

params.name: page
params.description: The 1-based page index.

params.name: page_size
params.description: The number of items per page.

params.name: sort
params.description: Sort fields. Prefix with - for descending order (e.g. -created_at).

params.name: id
params.description: Filter by id.

params.name: participant_id
params.description: Filter by participant_id.

params.name: created_at
params.description: Filter by created_at.

params.name: logic
params.description: How to combine the field filters: "and" (default) requires every filter to match, "or" requires any of them to match.
